raw_segments.text: Cymbeline, laud we the gods, and let our crooked smokes climb to their nostrils from our blessed
Publish we this peace to all our subjects.
Set we forward, let a Roman and a British ensign wave friendly together.
So through Lud's town march, and in the temple of Great Jupiter our peace will ratify, seal
Set on there, never was a war did cease, ere bloody hands were washed with such a peace.
